name: commit_siblings
description: Minimum number of concurrent open transactions required before applying commit_delay to enable commit grouping.
symptoms: Poor commit throughput under high concurrency
Increased latency for individual commits when grouping is missed
Suboptimal I/O batching for synchronous commits
tuning_tips: Increase this value under high-concurrency workloads with many short transactions to improve commit grouping; reduce or set to 0 to disable grouping logic entirely. Monitor commit latency and WAL write patterns when adjusting.
